items.headline: CJ CUP Byron Nelson lead
items.text: Si Woo Kim leads THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson at 21-under through the first hole of the final round, with Scottie Scheffler and Wyndham Clark two shots behind at 19-under.

items.headline: Final round tee times set
items.text: Si Woo Kim and Scottie Scheffler will play the final pairing at THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson, teeing off last at 1:40 p.m. at TPC Craig Ranch.

items.headline: Leaderboard updates available
items.text: Live updates, scores, and highlights for the final round of THE CJ CUP Byron Nelson are available through Golfweek and the PGA Tour official leaderboard.
